title: Google Ads
summary: Search ads when you want calls this month, quoted around your budget. Not bundled into the monthly SEO plans.
metaTitle: Google Ads Management | Nick Perry Digital
metaDescription: Google Ads management for Western Slope businesses, priced as a custom quote. Separate from the $850 and $1,500 SEO plans.
body:
Ads are for demand you want to buy while SEO and the listing compound. I manage search campaigns for businesses that already know which jobs are worth a lead. The management fee is a custom quote based on the account and the ad budget. Google bills the ad spend itself.

This is not the same thing as Local Services Ads. Where a category qualifies, Local Services Ads setup and management sit inside the monthly plans. Standard Google Ads, the auctions with keywords and ads you write, are the add-on.
gets: A recommendation on whether ads are even a fit
Campaign structure around services and towns, not one mixed ad group
Conversion tracking for calls and forms before spend scales up
A plain report on spend, calls, and wasted queries

steps.title: Decide
steps.text: If the site or the listing cannot take a call cleanly, we fix that before buying more traffic.

steps.title: Launch small
steps.text: The first weeks are for learning which searches are real jobs and which are noise.

steps.title: Trim
steps.text: I cut queries that do not match the work and shift budget toward the ones that do.

faqs.q: Is Google Ads included in the $850 plan?
faqs.a: No. Search ads management is a custom quote. Local Services Ads, where Google offers them for your category, are part of the monthly plans.

faqs.q: How much should I budget for ads?
faqs.a: That depends on the job and the town. I will not invent a number on this page. On the strategy call we look at what a lead is worth and start from there.
Yes. The account should be created under your Google login. I get access to manage it. If we stop, the campaigns stay with you.
They can cover a gap. They do not build the listing or the site. When the spend stops, the calls from ads stop with it.
